rows.note: Use this for the physical repair and regeneration of body cells or tissue.

example.english: After surgery, the healing of the wound takes some time.
example.traditional: 手術後，傷口嘅修復需要一段時間。
example.jyutping: sau2 seot6 hau6 soeng1 hau2 ge3 sau1 fuk6 seoi1 jiu3 jat1 dyun6 si4 gaan3

rows.note: Use this for emotional or psychological healing rather than physical repair.

example.english: Psychological healing is very important for me to move on from the gloom.
example.traditional: 心理療癒對我走出陰霾好重要。
example.jyutping: sam1 lei5 liu4 jyu6 deoi3 ngo5 zau2 ceot1 jam1 maai4 hou2 zung6 jiu3
